lines.beaver_en: I'm so excited about the concert the day after tomorrow!
lines.en: Me too. I want to go to the concert soon.

lines.beaver_en: What kind of music do you like?
lines.en: I like K-pop songs. I like upbeat music.

lines.beaver_en: Do you have a favorite song?
lines.en: Yes, I like a song called Spring Day.

lines.beaver_en: Will they sing that song at the concert?
lines.en: It would be great if they sing that song.

lines.learner: 네, 그 노래가 나오면 춤을 추고 싶어요.
lines.en: Yes, when that song plays, I want to dance.
lines.roman: ne, geu noraega naomyeon chumeul chugo sipeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: What about TV dramas or plays?
lines.learner: 드라마를 자주 봐요. 연극은 아직 안 봤어요.
lines.en: I often watch dramas. I haven't seen a play yet.
lines.roman: deuramareul jaju bwayo. yeongeugeun ajik an bwasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Do you have a favorite actor?
lines.en: Yes, I like actors who are also good at singing.

lines.beaver: 저는 연극을 보고 싶어요. 다음에 같이 가요.
lines.beaver_en: I want to see a play. Let's go together next time.
lines.beaver_roman: jeoneun yeongeugeul bogo sipeoyo. daeume gachi gayo.
lines.en: Sounds good. I want to see a play too.

lines.beaver: 모레 여섯 시에 공연장 앞에서 만나요.
lines.beaver_en: Let's meet in front of the venue at six, the day after tomorrow.
lines.beaver_roman: more yeoseot sie gongyeonjang apeseo mannayo.
lines.en: Okay, if I'm late, I'll call you.

lines.beaver_en: Great. See you the day after tomorrow!
